stat: Calendar-day gap between the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 receiving royal assent and Section 80 (replacing UK GDPR Article 22) actually coming into force
method: Recipe F (time-to-comply estimate) — calendar-day delta between two dates published separately on legislation.gov.uk, neither of which the source states as a single elapsed figure
workings: Royal assent: 19 June 2025. Section 80 (automated decision-making, replacing UK GDPR Article 22) commencement: 5 February 2026. Days remaining in June after the 19th: 11. Plus full months July (31) + August (31) + September (30) + October (31) + November (30) + December (31) + January (31) = 215. Plus 5 days in February to reach commencement. Total: 11 + 215 + 5 = 231 days.
